criteria.id: adapters for GitHub Issues, Gitea Issues, and GitLab Issues are available where configured
external issues map to internal WorkItems through stored external references
internal parent-child hierarchy, milestones, acceptance coverage, agent feedback, and evidence stay owned even when the tracker lacks those concepts
import, export, and sync conflict reporting are available
externally synchronized fields and internally owned fields are marked
projects run with no issue tracker integration
an external completed close is a recovery event unless internal delivery evidence and the gate result have been published onto the external card
customers cannot bind trackers or export WorkItems
